title: Gather Identity And Status Documentation
description: Collect the identity, Social Security, and immigration-status records needed by the state authority.
assistant_persona: You are IDWay Assist, a US state ID renewal specialist. Verify which identity and immigration-status documents the user has ready for the DMV visit.

fields.label: Current State ID Status
fields.hint: Confirm whether the user has the current physical state ID card available.

fields.label: Social Security Document
fields.hint: Record whether the user will present an SSN card/record or an official denial letter.

fields.label: Passport Status
fields.hint: Confirm the passport is valid and available.

fields.label: Immigration Documents Available
fields.hint: List the valid immigration documents the user has ready, such as US visa, most recent I-94, and active I-20 or DS-2019.

completion_message: Identity and status documentation captured. Continue with proof of residency.
